listing.summary: Lets the player build and fly the Tesseract ship.
listing.aiSummary: Lets the player build and fly the Tesseract ship.

description:
Tesseract Prototype

Download Patreon Free

Ever wanted to fly a Tesseract? well now you can!

This mod lets the player make and fly the tesseract. it does have the shard spawner hull mod removed, so when it dies it will not spawn new ships like usual there is no way around that.

Also all stats are left unchanged and its 500k to build

You get the blueprint to make the ship instantly.

My other mod- Radiant Prototype

My other mod- Guardian Prototype

Credits

Arthr- Sprite work

ChangeLog-1.1- Added updated sprite that includes a small bridge at front middle of ship

* Updated mod info

aiDescription: Adds the Tesseract ship to the game, providing the blueprint instantly upon installation. The ship retains its original stats and costs 500k to build, but lacks the shard spawner hull mod so it does not spawn new ships upon destruction.
